t: A Tribe Called Quest
s: A Tribe Called Quest is Q-Tip, Phife Dawg, Ali Shaheed Muhammad, and sometimes Jarobi. They started the Native Tongues movement with the Jungle Brothers, De La Soul, and Black Sheep. ATCQ were inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2024.

t: A Tribe Called Quest - YouTube
